note: Light presets (docs/light/PLAN.md). Directions are given in image terms for the front camera; the subject never changes, so the light is the only variable.

forms.setting: standing in the middle of an empty room with plain white plaster walls and a pale wooden floor, a tall window in the wall at image-left just out of frame
forms.desc: soft indirect daylight from a large window at image-left, no direct sun, the mannequin's right side brightly lit falling off gradually to shadow on its left side, the far wall darker, soft shadow edge
forms.keep: large soft window light from image-left, gradual fall-off to the right, no direct sun

forms.setting: standing in the middle of an empty room with plain white plaster walls and a pale wooden floor, a window high in the wall at image-left
forms.desc: direct afternoon sun through the window at image-left falling as a sharp-edged bright rectangle across the mannequin's torso and onto the floor, the rest of the room in dim warm bounce light, hard contrast
forms.keep: sharp-edged sun rectangle across the torso and floor from image-left, dim room around
checks: 一块边缘清晰的方形光斑

forms.setting: standing in the middle of an empty room with plain white plaster walls and a pale wooden floor, venetian blinds on a window at image-left
forms.desc: hard sunlight through half-open venetian blinds at image-left, parallel slanted stripes of light and shadow across the mannequin, the sphere and the back wall, warm 4500 K
forms.keep: parallel slanted light stripes from blinds at image-left across figure, sphere and wall
checks: 条纹落在人台、球和墙上

forms.setting: standing in the middle of an empty room with plain white plaster walls and a pale wooden floor, a wide window with white sheer curtains filling the wall behind the mannequin
forms.desc: bright daylight glowing through white sheer curtains directly behind the mannequin, the mannequin softly backlit with a light halo on its outline, its front in gentle low-contrast shade, airy high-key mood
forms.keep: bright sheer-curtain backlight, soft outline halo, gentle front shade, high-key

forms.setting: standing in the middle of an empty room with plain white plaster walls and a pale wooden floor, a square skylight in the ceiling directly above
forms.desc: soft daylight falling straight down from a skylight above, bright tops of the head and shoulders, the sphere lit on top, a soft round pool of light on the floor around the feet, the room edges dark
forms.keep: soft top light from a skylight, bright tops, pool of light on the floor, dark edges

forms.setting: standing just inside a dark room with dark walls, an open doorway at image-right
forms.desc: daylight entering only through an open doorway at image-right, strong side light on the mannequin's left side, the rest of the figure falling into deep shadow, the room around almost black, painterly chiaroscuro
forms.keep: single doorway light from image-right, strong side light, deep shadow, near-black room

forms.setting: standing in the open shade of a tall plain building wall behind the camera, a sunny street in the distance behind
forms.desc: soft cool light from the open sky above and in front, no direct sun on the mannequin, very soft shadows, the sunlit background behind brighter and warmer than the figure
forms.keep: open shade, soft cool sky light, no sun on the figure, brighter warm background

forms.setting: standing on a forest path under a leafy tree canopy
forms.desc: midday sun filtering through the leaves above, scattered round bright dapples of sunlight on the mannequin, the sphere and the ground, the rest in soft green-tinted shade
forms.keep: scattered sun dapples through leaves on figure, sphere and ground, green-tinted shade
checks: 身上和地上有斑驳光点

forms.setting: standing on a flat snowfield under a clear sky
forms.desc: bright winter sun from image-left at 25 degrees with strong light bouncing up from the white snow, the shadow side and the undersides of the arms and chin filled brightly, very bright overall, cool blue shadows on the snow
forms.keep: winter sun from image-left, strong upward snow bounce filling undersides, bright overall, blue snow shadows

forms.setting: standing on a stone poolside edge, a sunlit pool of water just in front of the feet
forms.desc: sun from behind the mannequin reflecting off rippling water in front, moving bright caustic ripple patterns projected onto the mannequin's front and the sphere, soft overall light
forms.keep: rippling caustic light patterns from the water on the front of the figure and the sphere

forms.setting: standing inside a plain concrete tunnel near its mouth, the bright opening behind
forms.desc: the bright daylit tunnel opening behind the mannequin, the figure nearly silhouetted with a thin bright outline, light reflecting along the tunnel floor toward the camera, front very dark
forms.keep: bright tunnel mouth behind, near-silhouette with thin outline, floor reflection
